connectors.name: DEBUG UART header (top edge)
connectors.orderNote: No pin 1 mark; started at the end closest to a USB connector (the USB-A HOST port on the left is nearer than the USB-C power port on the right), i.e. left end as displayed

uncertain: Board has two USB connectors (USB-A host at left, USB-C power at right); start end chosen by nearest USB connector (USB-A). Using the USB-C port would reverse the order.
A single black pin labeled WAKE sits immediately left of the DEBUG header; it was treated as a separate part and not transcribed. It may be part of the same physical row.
The 40-pin header along the bottom edge shows only pin numbers 1, 15, 29, 39 and no function labels, so it was not transcribed.
notes: Image is titled Debug pin connection and highlights only the 3-pin DEBUG header (labels printed rotated 180 degrees). A BOOT header and a 40-pin header are visible but have no per-pin function labels.
